units.label: A1
units.name: Tokens & Treats
units.about: Make your gift feel personal with Tokens & Treats. Discover personalised cards, bags and T-shirts for thoughtful everyday presents. Explore wedding favours and decorated glassware for celebrations. Add a personal touch to every occasion.

units.name: Lilac Domino
units.about: Get ready to start your next craft project at Lilac Domino. Take a look through our range of wool and yarn, alongside supplies for sewing and needlework. Whether you enjoy knitting, stitching or creating something by hand, explore the range with your next project in mind.

units.label: A5/6
units.name: Moroccan Corner
units.about: Discover a taste of Moroccan craftsmanship at Moroccan Corner. This small, independent shop offers Moroccan artisan goods and crafts. Explore what Moroccan Corner has to offer at Wood Street Indoor Market.

image.alt: Inside Moroccan Corner: stacked rugs, leather bags, poufs and painted ceramics

units.label: A8
units.name: Tony Shoe Sale
units.about: Discover rare second-hand shoes at Tony Shoe Sale, specialising in trainers, high-tops and casual footwear. Take a look through shelves packed with distinctive styles. Alongside the footwear, browse a selection of bags and denim clothing.

units.label: A9
units.name: Ray's Records
units.about: Make time for a musical browse at Ray’s Records, one of Wood Street Indoor Market’s independent record shops. Explore the selection and see what catches your ear.

units.label: A10
units.name: Malaya Therapies
units.about: Take some time for yourself at Malaya Therapies. Run by Kylie Marks, the practice offers osteopathy alongside a range of massage treatments. These include deep tissue and sports massage, as well as pregnancy and lymphatic drainage massage.

units.label: A12/13
units.name: Claudia Rose Lashes/Mimi Rose
units.about: Discover your lash style at Claudia Rose Lashes. Explore a choice of classic, hybrid and volume eyelash extensions to find your preferred look. Appointments are also available for infills and eyelash extension removal.

units.label: A14
units.name: Beauty @ Anu
units.about: Enjoy a little time for yourself at Beauty @ Anu. Explore the beauty salon’s range of treatments, including eyebrow threading and tinting. Waxing, facials and Indian head massage are also available.

units.label: A15
units.name: Mike's Record Shop
units.about: Take some time to explore the second-hand vinyl at Mike’s Record Shop. Browse a range of music spanning rock, punk, new wave, blues, jazz, folk, reggae and soul. Look through the records for an old favourite or something new to discover.

units.label: A16
units.name: Mrs Tinsley's Vintage & Retro
units.about: Explore finds from the past at Mrs Tinsley’s Vintage & Retro. This small vintage and antiques shop offers furniture, lighting and decorative pieces to browse. You’ll also find a selection of art, advertising collectibles, clothing and textiles.

image.alt: Mrs Tinsley's Vintage and Retro, framed pictures and prints hung around the shop window

units.name: SRK Delight
units.about: Enjoy freshly made drinks and a taste of Jamaica at SRK Delight. Semone’s juice bar serves a selection of fruit juices, smoothies and fruit cups. You’ll also find sugarcane juice and coconut water, alongside Jamaican drinks and snacks.

units.name: RoseCraft Jewellers
units.about: Create something personal with bespoke jewellery at RoseCraft Jewellers. Give a treasured piece a new lease of life with the jeweller’s repair services. Available services include stone replacement, engraving, polishing and refurbishment.

units.name: Rinkies Toys
units.about: Find something to spark playtime at Rinkies Toys. Browse a selection of toys, games and gifts for children. Explore everything from baby toys and cuddly plush characters to LEGO and action figures.

units.name: Books From Boxes
units.about: Find your next read at Books From Boxes. Tucked inside Wood Street Indoor Market, this independent bookshop offers a mix of new and second-hand books to browse. You’ll also find a small selection of stationery alongside the books.

units.name: Vintage Tony
units.about: Explore men’s fashion from decades past at Vintage Tony. The shop specialises mainly in clothing from the 1960s and 1970s, with vintage pieces available for both sale and hire. Browse a selection that also includes sportswear and trainers.

units.name: Pritzy Ltd
units.about: Add a little character to your wardrobe or home at Pritzy. Browse vintage-inspired jewellery, bags, hats and fashion accessories. Explore bridal accessories and gifts too, alongside decorative pieces for your home.

image.alt: The Pritzy shopfront, a black fascia over white-framed windows of bags, hats and jewellery, with the door open onto the room beyond

units.name: Sustainable style by S&K
units.about: Give pre-loved fashion another outing with Sustainable style by S&K. Take a look through the range of vintage and retro clothing. Find something with a history of its own to add to your wardrobe.

units.name: Music Family Records
units.about: Browse the records and CDs at Music Family Records. Take your time exploring the music on offer and revisiting a favourite. You might also find something new to add to your collection.

image.alt: Music Family Records, cut-paper lettering above open white doors, racks of LPs inside and bunting across the corridor

units.name: Timmy Tapers Ltd
units.about: Freshen up your look with a haircut from Timmy Tapers. The barbering business currently advertises both mobile and home appointments. To arrange your booking, get in touch with Timmy Tapers directly.

units.name: Mykeyartzone
units.about: Discover colourful artwork at Mykeyartzone, a small studio gallery tucked inside Wood Street Indoor Market. Take time to browse portraits, landscapes and illustrated pieces in a variety of styles. Explore the artwork and find something to bring character to your walls.

image.alt: Mykeyartzone, a lilac double doorway under a hand-painted sign, the studio walls hung with prints and paintings and two visitors at the threshold

units.name: Disc Disciple Records
units.about: Explore the second-hand vinyl at Disc Disciple Records. Browse music spanning rock, punk, new wave, blues, jazz, folk, reggae and soul. Take your time looking for a much-loved album or discovering something new to add to your collection.

units.name: 1 Vintage Place
units.about: Discover vintage finds with a timeless feel. Explore retro treasures, each with a story to tell. Embrace sustainable style with one-of-a-kind pieces.

image.alt: The corner shopfront of 1 Vintage Place, its sign over glazed windows of framed pictures and curios, with a shopper looking in

units.name: Flowerie88
units.about: Discover handmade jewellery and fashion accessories at Flowerie88, created by Japanese designer and maker Rie Tanabe. The shop also offers jewellery repairs, alterations and remodelling. Give your treasured pieces a fresh chapter with these services.

units.name: Jimmy Mack Vintage & Retro
units.about: Explore fashion and finds from the past at Jimmy Mack Vintage & Retro. Browse a selection of vintage and retro clothing, alongside film annuals and collectibles. Discover a little everyday nostalgia as you look through what’s on offer.
